meta.notes: Story-mode steps; bodies are templated at export time from the exported numbers. Each selector starts with the data-story attribute the screen renders (story_id), optionally narrowed to a child element so the step card does not cover its subject: aog-incident-ps1, aircraft, rotable-float-calc, network-bom, action-inbox, frontier-chart. mobile_selector (or null) is the narrower target used at <= 480 px (bottom-sheet layout); it also starts with the story_id hook.

steps.title: 1 · The operational problem
steps.body: A6-FHW (fictional) is on the ground at BOM: a D0 nose wheel steering actuator (NB) failed and none was held there. It waited 14 h. Ranked on what the desk knew then, the best route was: Transfer from AUH.

steps.title: 2 · Diagnose the shortage
steps.body: ATA 32 rates URGENT, led by GN-32-R014, a D0 nose wheel steering actuator (NB) with risk 100/100. With 0 units at BOM under P0, it caused 464 AOG h across all stations in the last 52 weeks (W52–W103).

steps.title: 3 · The repair pipeline
steps.body: Pooled across the network, the recommended 17 spares (14 on the shelf + 3 in repair) cover over 99.9% of removals. An aircraft at BOM can only use the 2 units there: on its 77-day loop, Palm's theorem gives 61%. Station figures, not pooled ones, decide AOG hours.

steps.title: 4 · Compare the trade-offs
steps.body: At BOM, holdout material AOG falls from 242 h/yr under P0 to 6 under P2, the network plan I125 builds on. I125 adds 1 unit here (12 vs 11) and holds network AOG to 76 h/yr. Each emergency hop from AUH takes 9 h.

steps.title: 5 · Recommend the action
steps.body: The action centre raises 63 exceptions for W103, 25 urgent. At BOM, GN-32-R014 has 0 of 2 on hand, with 7 D0 requests and 75 AOG h there in the last 52 weeks (W52–W103). Action: Position 2 units at BOM (station target 0 -> 2); AUH has none serviceable — source via repair/exchange.

steps.title: 6 · Business value on the Readiness Frontier
steps.body: Positioning cuts material AOG by 1,480 h a year for AED 615k more capital. If you invest an additional AED 7.6M, the pre-stated rule stops at I125: a further 134 AOG h/yr [87–181] below P2 (paired holdout). It picks I110 at ×0.5 the hourly rate; B150 at ×2.0 the hourly rate.
